requirements.quote: Inspect the three log files and extract **only** the lines that a) belong to 12-June-2024 and b) are classified as either “ERROR” or “CRITICAL”.

check.cmd:
python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import re, sys
srcs = ['app1.log', 'app2.log', 'system.log']
lines = {s: open('/home/user/incident_logs/' + s).read().splitlines() for s in srcs}
out = open('/home/user/incident_logs/critical_2024-06-12.log').read()
O = out.splitlines()
def want(s, l):
    d = 'Jun 12' if s == 'system.log' else '2024-06-12'
    return d in l and re.search(r'\b(ERROR|CRITICAL)\b', l)

ok = bool(O) and all(any(l in lines[s] and want(s, l) for s in srcs) for l in O)
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
PYEOF
